steps.description: Implement the family function for the rigid constraint family (low-dimensional linear system) and the fat constraint family (high-dimensional polynomial space) to feed into the existing capacity_scan pipeline. This requires defining X, y, Xv, yv arrays with proper reshaping and random number generation using the provided seed. The goal is to test whether N_c(w) is non-increasing (rigid) or increasing (fat) as w grows.

plans.objective: [DIM: topological] The solution space exhibits a phase transition at $w \approx 2d$ (where $d$ is input dimension), transitioning from a rigid (zero-dimensional) to a fat (continuous) manifold; the apparent rigidity in small-$w$ regimes is due to undersampling the true topological structure.

This will enable testing whether N_c(w) is non-increasing (rigid) or increasing (fat) as w grows, with a phase transition near w ≈ 2d. The code will use the existing capacity_scan pipeline without modifying it, only defining the data generation logic.
